Residential Unit Mix Model

This task starts from scratch with no init_file inputs and no local reference images. Create an OpenStudio 3.10 one-story residential unit mix model and save the required outputs as /home/user/Desktop/result.osm and /home/user/Desktop/kpis.json.

## Pass conditions
1. The output folder contains /home/user/Desktop/result.osm with size at least 500 bytes and /home/user/Desktop/kpis.json with size at least 10 bytes.
2. /home/user/Desktop/result.osm contains exactly one OS:Version object whose version identifier starts with 3.10.
3. /home/user/Desktop/result.osm contains exactly 1 OS:BuildingStory, 6 OS:Space objects, 6 OS:ThermalZone objects, and 6 OS:ZoneHVAC:EquipmentList objects.
4. The OS:Space names are exactly Unit-1, Unit-2, Unit-3, Unit-4, Corridor, and Stair.
5. Every OS:Space references the OS:BuildingStory, references an OS:ThermalZone, and has floor area greater than 0.05 m2.
6. The model has exactly 40 OS:Surface objects: 6 Floor surfaces, 6 RoofCeiling surfaces, and 28 Wall surfaces.
7. The surface Outside Boundary Condition counts are exactly 6 Ground, 16 Outdoors, and 18 Surface.
8. The model has exactly 6 OS:SubSurface objects whose Sub Surface Type is Door.
9. The surface geometry bounding box has X span 24.00 m, Y span 8.00 m, and Z span 3.00 m, each with tolerance +/-0.05 m.
10. The sum of floor surface areas is 192.00 m2 with tolerance +/-0.50 m2.
11. The sum of exterior wall gross areas is 192.00 m2 with tolerance +/-0.50 m2.
12. /home/user/Desktop/kpis.json contains unit_count, residential_floor_area_m2, common_floor_area_m2, and exterior_door_count values matching the evaluator-computed model metrics with tolerance max(0.10, 1%).

Any item not explicitly required in the pass conditions may vary.
